Real-world KCNA deployments must protect data across tenants; this question probes envelope encryption design, key lifecycle, and how to audit and delete data without breaking consistency.

## Key Concepts
- Envelope encryption
- Per-tenant KEK/DEK lifecycle
- Key rotation with zero-downtime re-encryption
- Auditability and tenant-scoped deletion

## Code Example

```javascript
const wrappedDek = metadata.getTenantWrappedDek(tenantId);
const dek = kms.unwrapDek(tenantId, wrappedDek);
const plaintext = crypto.decrypt(payload, dek);
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test key rotation without service disruption?
- How do you enforce least-privilege access per tenant across decryptors?
